Districts.Name: Eastwater
Districts.Description: One of Port Arden's oldest neighborhoods: shotgun houses and brick fourplexes on the bayou side of Tidewater Avenue. Tight-knit, underinvested, fiercely proud.

Districts.Name: Harbor Row
Districts.Description: The commercial strip where Tidewater Avenue meets the old wharves: brick storefronts, new mid-rises, the precinct house and Arden General's east campus.

Districts.Name: Channelside
Districts.Description: Warehouses, truck yards and the flare stacks of Calloway Chemical along the Arden Ship Canal. Twenty-four-hour work, empty at night except for the trucks.

Districts.Name: Arden Central
Districts.Description: The skyline: Meridian Tower over Founders' Square, City Hall, hotels, museums and the transit hub. Busy by day, spotty by night.

Districts.Name: The Ledger
Districts.Description: Banks, trading floors and law firms in glass towers. Packed at nine, empty by seven.

Districts.Name: Cotton Row
Districts.Description: Nineteenth-century brick warehouses turned galleries and restaurants. Tourists by day, preservation fights at every council meeting.

Districts.Name: Southgate Flats
Districts.Description: Dense older housing and struggling commercial strips, held together by strong churches and mutual aid.

Districts.Name: Port of Arden
Districts.Description: Container terminal, cranes, customs and rail yards: 24-hour logistics on the ship channel.

Districts.Name: Fairhaven
Districts.Description: 1960s ranch houses, strip malls, good schools and ball fields.

Districts.Name: Pinecrest Hollow
Districts.Description: Newer subdivisions, megachurches, big-box retail and a long commute.

Districts.Name: Oak Terrace
Districts.Description: Old-money mansions under live oaks, private clubs and quiet, well-patrolled streets.

Districts.Name: Riverbend Estates
Districts.Description: Gated new money on the river: security patrols, golf and three-car garages.

Districts.Name: Mercer Heights
Districts.Description: Tarrow State University, student housing, cheap bars and the research labs of the Halvorsen Institute.

Districts.Name: Lantana Park
Districts.Description: The stadium district: The Breakwater, Riggers Park and fan bars that fill up on game days.

Districts.Name: Westmarch Commons
Districts.Description: The shopping district: the Westmarch Commons mall, an outlet strip and auto row.

Districts.Name: Coquina Key
Districts.Description: The barrier island: beaches, the Boardwalk and Pleasure Pier, beach houses, marinas and fishing.

Districts.Name: Bitterwater Marsh
Districts.Description: Bayous, boat ramps and a bird sanctuary, with fishing camps on stilts and a dumping problem nobody wants to talk about.

Districts.Name: Tarrow Prairie
Districts.Description: Ranches and rice farms along county roads, and the little town of Tarrow with its courthouse square.

Districts.Name: Kessler Field
Districts.Description: The regional airport, air cargo sheds and general-aviation hangars on the metro's northern edge.
